description:
Tipping customs for one country: data.norms.value {overall_context, situations {<situation>: {expectation, guidance_type, percent_min, percent_max}}}; percentages only where a source states them. Use it for "should I tip, and how much?"; get_country_facts for several facts, get_trip_brief for a whole trip. Custom, not law: confidence reflects that. Each fact is cited: sources[] (url, license), last_verified, confidence.
Parameters: omit situation for all; one situation returns only that (no data gives empty situations, not an error). Examples: {"country":"US"}, {"country":"JP","situation":"taxi"}.
Read-only; keyless (free key or x402 lifts limits: https://citedtravel.com/pricing/); errors RFC 9457.

country.description: Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, case-insensitive (e.g. JP, jp or JPN). Names are not accepted: resolve them with resolve_country first.

lang.description: Language for localized names (BCP 47). Supported: en, ja, zh-Hans, zh-Hant; aliases such as zh, zh-CN, zh-TW and zh-HK are mapped, and anything else falls back to English. Only names are localized; verbatim official quotes stay in their original language.

situation.description: Return only this situation. A situation with no data gives an empty situations object (not an error). Omit for all situations.

name: get_tipping_norms
